name: ExynosTools Xclipse LSFG r6
description: Samsung Xclipse compatibility driver for stock GameNative 1.2.0 wrappers. r6 keeps the Android hwvulkan HAL and stable hosted-dispatch integration, and consumes only ExynosTools' virtual textureCompressionBC device feature before the real Samsung vkCreateDevice call so DXVK can use BCn emulation without asking Xclipse to enable unsupported native BC compression.
author: Vortek / ExynosTools
driverVersion: Samsung hwvulkan HAL + virtual BC device-feature consume r6
